heading: Engineers ship faster with Helix
description: From solo founders to staff engineers and AI teams, Helix replaces sprawling diffs with small, reviewable PRs grounded in your codebase.

testimonials.quote: Helix turned our AI coding experiments into actual shipping units. Instead of one massive diff, we get 6 to 10 small PRs that each compile, lint, and pass tests in isolation.
I describe a feature in a sentence and wake up to PRs that respect our existing module boundaries. The atomic work-breakdown is what made Helix click for us.
My team stopped debating agent prompts and started reviewing PRs. Helix gives every unit its own dependency map, so we finally trust the agent's output.
The verification step is the differentiator. Helix checks each unit against types, tests, and lint before it ever shows up in my review queue.
We replaced a brittle homegrown orchestrator with Helix in a weekend. The dependency-aware execution is exactly the model our AI workflows needed.
Replays are the killer feature for me. When a run fails I can re-run a single unit without burning the whole budget on a retry.
